name: complydoc
description: Open your documents in Claude with personal details masked and hidden instructions taken out.
long_description:
complydoc reads a document on your computer before the assistant does. Bank accounts, tax numbers, card numbers, emails and phone numbers come back masked, and text hidden from a reader, such as a white sentence telling the model what to conclude, is taken out. The file itself never leaves your computer: only the cleaned text joins the conversation, and complydoc makes no network connection while it reads.

Ask for a document instead of attaching it: *Open the Acme proposal and summarise it*, or *Can I share the Nordwind contract?*

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Find a document in your folder by part of its name.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Find which documents mention something, with the page.

tools.name: check_document

tools.name: check_folder
tools.description: Say which documents in a folder are safe to share.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Read a document with personal details masked and hidden passages taken out.

tools.name: request_unmask
